blocks.text: Insanon par trial se pehle compounds ko in vitro (lab mein cells ke culture par) aur in vivo (janwaron par) test kiya jata hai taa ke un ki hifazat (safety), zehreela pan (toxicity) aur asar (efficacy) naapa ja sake.
